newsitem.title: UK: Guinness launch smoother version in Panama.
newsitem.headline: Guinness launch smoother version in Panama.

text.p: Guinness Brewing Worldwide said on Wednesday it is launching a smoother version of its black beer in Panama with its local brewing partner Cervecceria del Baru.
The new variant will have a lower 5.7 percent alcohol by volume replacing the stronger Guinness Foreign Extra Stout which has been available in Panama since 1956.
Research by the company showed that Panamanian drinkers preferred the flavour of the smoother variant.
The new Guinness goes on sales in bars and supermarkets from Thursday in bottles and cans.
Over the last five years Panama's beer market has grown at a rate of two percent year on year.
